title: National Commission's Laying Down of Adequate Standards

content.scenario: A consumer in India files a complaint against a business, alleging that they have engaged in unfair practices. The National Commission receives this complaint and decides to lay down adequate standards in consultation with the Central Government from time to time.
content.outcome: The National Commission lays down adequate standards in consultation with the Central Government from time to time, for better protection of the interests of consumers and for that purpose, shall have administrative control over all the State Commissions in the following matters.
